description: REIT cash-flow skeleton for SIC 6798 retaining all 394 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied Realty Income reference guides broad presentation. Income-property, mortgage-investment, productive-asset and ownership flows preserve separate scopes; indirect-method adjustments, noncash transactions and acquisition allocations are not treated as interchangeable cash flows.
classification_notes: All 394 supplied concepts appear once. The SIC universe spans property-owning and mortgage REITs and is not a claim that Realty Income reports every concept.
The reference guides presentation only. Its funds-from-operations caption is not assumed to equal REIT FFO. No FFO, AFFO, free-cash-flow or other unsupported analytical subtotal is manufactured.

Total operating, investing and financing cash-flow nodes contain classification families. Continuing and discontinued scopes, gross/net alternatives and overlapping components do not imply arithmetic.

Real-estate acquisition, development, construction, improvements, initial direct leasing costs and tenant improvements overlap; do not infer maintenance/growth capex or merge owner-used productive assets with investment property.
Direct property and JV/equity-method investments overlap combined property/JV flows. Operating distributions from earnings differ from return-of-investment investing receipts.
Investment loans and held-for-sale loans preserve different purposes. Generic loan flows and reverse repos remain supplementary review candidates until issuer classification is established.

Related-party, collateral, maturity, instrument and seniority views of borrowing overlap. Net debt/equity/derivative flow directions follow each taxonomy definition and issuer source, not the first word in its tag.
Acquisition-date allocation values, assumed debt, noncash stock/lease transactions, unpaid capex and portfolio transfers are supplementary and never automatic cash flows.

The supplied FX measure covers continuing operations; total cash change includes disposal/discontinued operations. Match populations before reconciling; do not force an identity across mismatched scopes.

Cash balances and acquisition allocations retain official instant periods; cash movements and other supplied measures retain duration. All 394 concepts are monetary; all contra flags are false and imply no automatic sign reversal.

metadata_contract.period_type: Verified against official US GAAP 2026: 380 duration and 14 instant concepts. Instant cash balances and acquisition allocations are intentionally retained.
metadata_contract.unit_type: All 394 concepts are monetary in the official schema; currency and scale must come from source facts.
metadata_contract.contra: False throughout; raw fact direction and issuer earnings-to-cash reversal require explicit reconciliation, not automatic expense negation.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 394 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 6798.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

nodes.label: Operating activities
nodes.classification_note: The reported total contains presentation families; continuing/discontinued scopes and overlapping reconciliation views are not automatically additive.

children.label: Profit and operating cash-flow scopes
children.classification_note: Consolidated profit includes NCI. Continuing/discontinued cash flows are alternative scope details of total operating cash flow, not earnings adjustments.

children.label: Rental and lease earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Straight-line rent and above/below-market adjustments can overlap rental receivable and intangible amortization movements. Reconcile lessor versus lessee roles and signs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:StraightLineRent
concepts.review_reason: Straight-line rent measures the difference between rent due and rent recognized; it can overlap StraightLineRentAdjustments and rental receivable changes, so reconcile the issuer adjustment sign.

concepts.name: us-gaap:StraightLineRentAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Straight-line rental revenue adjustments can represent the same due-versus-recognized rent difference as StraightLineRent; do not reverse both or duplicate rental receivable changes.

children.label: Amortization of above and below market leases

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfAboveAndBelowMarketLeases
concepts.review_reason: Above- and below-market lease amortization nets asset and liability effects; it overlaps the below-market-only amount and can be included in intangible amortization.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfBelowMarketLease
concepts.review_reason: Below-market lease amortization is a component of the above-and-below-market net lease adjustment; retain the liability/asset effect and avoid double counting.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnTerminationOfLease
concepts.review_reason: Lease termination earnings can arise from either lessor or lessee transactions and can include cash settlements; reconcile the issuer reversal rather than assuming the entire result is noncash.

children.label: Depreciation, amortization and accretion adjustments
children.classification_note: Combined D&A or net accretion totals overlap all their asset and financing components. Select reported aggregate or matched details; no synthetic subtotal is calculated.

children.label: Depreciation and amortization aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: These classifications are presentation families, not instructions to sum facts. Select issuer-reconciled alternatives and preserve source signs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet
concepts.review_reason: Net depreciation/amortization/accretion can contain property depreciation, lease/intangible amortization and investment accretion supplied separately; reconcile the issuer component coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Depreciation, depletion and amortization overlaps depreciation and other amortization disclosures, and may be included in the broader net accretion aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdjustmentForAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Aggregate amortization can contain intangibles, deferred charges and financing adjustments reported separately; use only the issuer-reconciled aggregate or components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Residual depreciation and amortization may include amounts already in total D&A; establish which property and intangible charges the residual excludes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortizationDiscontinuedOperations
concepts.review_reason: Discontinued-operation D&A is an attribution subset of total D&A and must be matched to a starting profit measure that includes discontinued results.

children.label: Physical and intangible asset charges
children.classification_note: Depreciation, intangible amortization and lessee ROU amortization overlap broader D&A. Operating ROU amortization is not a second lease payment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets
concepts.review_reason: Intangible amortization can contain lease-related amounts also disclosed as above/below-market lease amortization; establish whether the lease adjustments are already included.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortizationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease ROU reduction is not a separate lease cash payment and may already be offset in lease liability or other operating changes; reconcile the indirect-method presentation.

children.label: Financing and investment amortization
children.classification_note: Borrower financing amortization and lender origination/investment accretion are distinct economic roles. The combined financing amount overlaps individual components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Financing-cost amortization can be included in the supplied financing-cost-and-discount aggregate; identify whether debt discounts are excluded from this amount.

children.label: Amortization of financing costs and discounts

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCostsAndDiscounts
concepts.review_reason: The financing-cost-and-discount amortization aggregate can contain both standalone financing-cost amortization and debt discount/premium amortization; select one reconciled presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremium
concepts.review_reason: Debt discount/premium amortization may already be included in financing-cost-and-discount amortization; preserve premium-versus-discount direction from the source.

children.label: Investment discount accretion and premium amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionAmortizationOfDiscountsAndPremiumsInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment accretion and amortization may already be included in the broader net depreciation/amortization/accretion adjustment; reconcile that aggregate before separate use.

children.label: Amortization of deferred loan origination fees net

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredLoanOriginationFeesNet
concepts.review_reason: Deferred loan origination fee/cost amortization changes lender interest income; it differs from borrower financing-cost amortization and from cash fees paid.

children.label: Deferred-charge amortization
children.classification_note: The total deferred-charge measure can include financing or leasing costs. The other deferred-charge measure is a residual, not a separate total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredCharges
concepts.review_reason: Deferred-charge amortization can contain deferred financing or leasing costs as well as the supplied other deferred-cost amortization; establish exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharges
concepts.review_reason: Other deferred-cost amortization is a residual within total deferred-charge amortization and may also appear within aggregate amortization.

children.label: Share-based compensation adjustments
children.classification_note: Expense views overlap; exclude capitalized award costs and share issuance values retained in supplementary disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Noncash share-based compensation may include allocated award and restricted-stock expense already supplied separately; select the issuer reconciliation amount without summing overlapping disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Allocated award expense excludes capitalized amounts and may overlap ShareBasedCompensation and restricted-stock expense; reconcile the issuer add-back coverage.

children.label: Restricted stock and unit noncash expense

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedStockExpense
concepts.review_reason: Restricted stock or unit expense is a subset of share-based compensation and may overlap allocated award expense; do not add it to the full award adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAcceleratedCompensationCost
concepts.review_reason: Accelerated share-based compensation is an additional award cost that may already be included in total or restricted-stock expense; isolate the incremental add-back.

children.label: Impairment and credit-loss adjustments
children.classification_note: Asset-class and ownership impairment views can be components of the total; impairment and disposal combined measures can contain these adjustments.

children.label: Property and other asset impairment
children.classification_note: These classifications are presentation families, not instructions to sum facts. Select issuer-reconciled alternatives and preserve source signs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate impairment can already be included in tangible, long-lived or all-asset impairment; identify the property population before selecting an add-back.

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets held for use

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-use long-lived impairment includes assets to be disposed of other than by sale; reconcile overlap with the separately supplied disposed-of asset impairment category.

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets to be disposed of

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedOf
concepts.review_reason: Impairment of long-lived assets to be disposed of differs from assets held for use; identify disposal-group coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill impairment can already be included in the broader impairment adjustment; identify the goodwill-only add-back.

children.label: Equity-method and partnership impairment
children.classification_note: Real-estate partnership impairment can overlap equity-method impairment depending on accounting method.

children.label: Equity method investment other than temporary impairment

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method other-than-temporary impairment is distinct from the investee earnings and disposal measures; identify inclusion in the net-income starting point.

children.label: Impairment losses related to real estate partnerships

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentLossesRelatedToRealEstatePartnerships
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate partnership impairment can be included in equity-method impairment or all-asset impairment; identify accounting method and ownership population.

children.label: Receivable loss provisions
children.classification_note: The loan/lease/other-loss provision includes multiple counterparty classes. Accounts, loan and financing-receivable provisions overlap the aggregate; accrued interest exclusions remain distinct.

children.label: Loan, lease and other loss provision

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses
concepts.review_reason: This broad loan, lease and other-loss provision can contain both financing-receivable and doubtful-account provisions; do not add its narrower provisions without reconciliation.

children.label: Financing receivable credit loss expense or reversal

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed
concepts.review_reason: Loan-loss expense is narrower than the loan/lease/other-loss provision and may overlap financing-receivable credit expense; identify the lending portfolio and accrued interest treatment.

children.label: Accounts receivable credit loss expense or reversal

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.review_reason: Accounts-receivable credit loss expense differs from loan provisions but can be included in the broader loan/lease/other-loss total.

children.label: Disposal and event earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Gains/losses are earnings adjustments rather than sale proceeds. Not every event result is wholly noncash; verify issuer reconciliation and avoid duplicate reversals.

children.label: Property disposal results
children.classification_note: Property type, use, discontinued attribution and inclusion of foreclosure write-downs distinguish these overlapping measures.

children.label: Gains losses on sales of investment real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Investment-real-estate sale gains overlap broader property-sale gains; confirm the investment-property population and earnings adjustment sign.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of properties

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperties
concepts.review_reason: The property-sale gain covers real estate intended for sale, appreciation or rental; it overlaps the narrower investment-property sale result and is not a sale receipt.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of property plant equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment
concepts.review_reason: This PP&E disposal result includes oil/gas and timber properties, unlike GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets; it can overlap real-estate and broader disposal adjustments.

children.label: Gain (loss) on PP&E disposal, excluding oil/gas and timber

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets
concepts.review_reason: This PP&E disposal result excludes oil/gas and timber property, while the separately supplied PP&E sale tag includes them; reconcile the asset population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfRealEstateDiscontinuedOperations
concepts.review_reason: Discontinued real-estate disposal gains differ in scope from all property gains and from the net-of-tax discontinued disposal result; reconcile attribution and tax basis.

children.label: Gains losses on sales of other real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Other-real-estate gains include foreclosure valuation allowance changes and write-downs as well as sales, so they overlap impairment and disposal adjustments.

children.label: Broad asset sale and impairment results
children.classification_note: Broad asset results may include subsidiary, equity-method and intangible disposals; combined sale-and-impairment amounts also overlap impairment charges.

children.label: Broad asset disposal gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1
concepts.review_reason: The broad asset disposal result includes PP&E, intangibles and subsidiary or equity-method interests; do not add those separately supplied gains without a reconciliation.

children.label: Combined asset sale and impairment result

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Combined asset sale and impairment results overlap separate sale gains and impairment charges; preserve whether the issuer presents a net adjustment or components.

children.label: Business disposal and consolidation results
children.classification_note: Sale, deconsolidation, bargain purchase, step-acquisition and nonbusiness VIE events preserve different recognition scopes. Gain-only and gain-or-loss remeasurement are alternatives.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness
concepts.review_reason: A business disposal gain is an earnings item, not cash consideration; identify attribution and whether it overlaps the separately supplied continuing-operation disposal gain.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeconsolidationGainOrLossAmount
concepts.review_reason: Deconsolidation gains cover subsidiary and specified business-asset derecognition and may overlap business-sale or broad disposal gains; they are not cash divested.

children.label: Discontinued disposal result net of tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposalOfDiscontinuedOperationNetOfTax
concepts.review_reason: The discontinued disposal result is net of tax and is not interchangeable with pretax property-disposal adjustments or discontinued cash flow.

children.label: Business combination bargain purchase gain recognized amount

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationBargainPurchaseGainRecognizedAmount
concepts.review_reason: A bargain purchase gain is a business-combination earnings adjustment and can already be included in broader acquisition or other noncash results.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationStepAcquisitionEquityInterestInAcquireeRemeasurementGain
concepts.review_reason: This step-acquisition remeasurement is gain-only and overlaps the supplied gain-or-loss alternative; it is not acquisition cash consideration.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationStepAcquisitionEquityInterestInAcquireeRemeasurementGainOrLoss
concepts.review_reason: The step-acquisition remeasurement gain-or-loss amount contains any gain-only amount reported separately; select one alternative.

children.label: Nonbusiness VIE initial consolidation gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityInitialConsolidationGainOrLoss
concepts.review_reason: Initial VIE consolidation gains/losses apply when the VIE is not a business; they are not business-combination consideration or cash proceeds.

children.label: Debt extinguishment results
children.classification_note: Pretax totals can include issuance-cost write-offs; before-write-off and net-of-tax results are different presentations. Cash extinguishment costs and debt principal are separate.

children.label: Debt extinguishment result before cost writeoff

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebtBeforeWriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCost
concepts.review_reason: The extinguishment result before deferred issuance cost write-off excludes the separately supplied write-off; it differs from the total extinguishment result.

children.label: Write Off Of Deferred Debt Issuance Cost

concepts.name: us-gaap:WriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCost
concepts.review_reason: Deferred debt issuance cost write-offs may already be included in the total extinguishment loss; the before-write-off extinguishment result is a separate alternative.

children.label: Debt extinguishment result net of tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossNetOfTax
concepts.review_reason: Debt extinguishment gains/losses net of tax differ from pretax total and before-write-off results; match the tax basis of the cash-flow starting profit.

children.label: Insurance and contingency results
children.classification_note: Earnings losses/recoveries differ from cash insurance settlements and may include accrual or valuation components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InsuredEventGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Insured-event gains/losses are the difference between recovery and insured loss, not the recovery cash proceeds; separate operating and investing insurance receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LossContingencyLossInPeriod
concepts.review_reason: Contingency loss/reversal is an earnings estimate and can include cash settlements; isolate the noncash portion and reconcile accrual movements.

children.label: Investment result adjustments
children.classification_note: Realized/unrealized, asset class and event scopes overlap. Reverse only amounts included in the chosen earnings starting measure, excluding OCI-only results.

children.label: General investment earnings results
children.classification_note: Realized all/other portfolio gains and loss-only views are alternatives or subsets; losses are not additional to a net result.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers investment disposal results rather than sale proceeds.

children.label: Gain or loss on disposal of other investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Other-investment disposal gains are earnings adjustments rather than investment sale proceeds; identify the portfolio and any inclusion in a broader gain adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LossOnSaleOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers investment sale losses alone, excluding sale gains.

children.label: Marketable and equity security results
children.classification_note: Broad marketable realized/unrealized results can include the corresponding FV-NI equity results. Realization scope does not establish additive components across portfolios.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers unrealized marketable-security changes that may include non-earnings valuation effects.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesRealizedGainLossExcludingOtherThanTemporaryImpairments
concepts.review_reason: Realized marketable-security results may overlap broad investment gains and FV-NI equity results; distinguish realization scope and exclude any OCI-only movements.

children.label: Unrealized FV-NI equity security gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: The unrealized FV-NI equity result is included in the combined realized-and-unrealized FV-NI result and can overlap broad unrealized investment gains.

children.label: Equity securities FV-NI realized gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers realized FV-NI equity-security results rather than unrealized changes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Broad unrealized investment gains may contain FV-NI equity gains; verify earnings recognition and the included portfolios rather than reversing OCI or adding overlapping adjustments.

children.label: Mortgage and equity-method disposal results
children.classification_note: MBS, mortgage-loan and equity-method results are earnings measures, not cash sale proceeds; broader investment results may already include them.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBS
concepts.review_reason: MBS sale earnings need an earnings-to-cash reconciliation and may overlap investment gains; they are not loan sale proceeds.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of mortgage loans

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers mortgage loan-sale results rather than the broader loan portfolio.

children.label: Equity method investment realized gain loss on disposal

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method disposal gains can be contained in broad asset or investment disposal adjustments; they differ from cash proceeds of selling the investment.

children.label: Derivative and currency earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Unrealized results, AOCI-to-earnings recycling and deferred amortization are distinct from settlement cash flows. Realized FX requires issuer reconciliation rather than automatic reversal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers unrealized derivative valuation changes that may be reported in earnings or OCI.

children.label: Interest rate hedge result reclassified to earnings

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestRateCashFlowHedgeGainLossReclassifiedToEarningsNet
concepts.review_reason: Interest-rate cash-flow hedge amounts reclassified from AOCI into earnings are not derivative settlement cash receipts or payments; establish any separate indirect-method reversal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredHedgeGains
concepts.review_reason: Deferred hedge gain/loss amortization affects earnings but is not a hedge settlement cash flow; reconcile inclusion in interest or other noncash adjustments.

children.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain Loss Unrealized

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnrealized
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized transaction earnings are distinct from the exchange-rate effect on reconciled cash balances; check operating adjustment signs.

children.label: Foreign currency transaction gain loss realized
Equity-method earnings and operating returns
children.classification_note: Gross equity-method earnings and distributions can be replaced by net-of-distributions earnings, not added to it. Return of investment is a separate investing receipt.

children.label: Income loss from equity method investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method earnings are distinct from cash distributions and disposal results; reverse only the earnings included in the selected income starting point.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: The definition classifies these equity-method receipts as operating return on investment; they can already be included in the net-of-distributions earnings adjustment and exclude investing capital returns.

children.label: Equity method income net of distributions

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsNetOfDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: This adjustment already nets equity-method dividends or distributions other than return of investment; avoid also counting the same operating distributions as an independent receipt.

children.label: Proceeds from distributions received from real estate partnerships

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDistributionsReceivedFromRealEstatePartnerships
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate partnership distributions are receipts from earnings; distinguish return on investment from investing returns of capital and reconcile equity-method distribution adjustments.

children.label: Tax reconciliation adjustments
children.classification_note: Deferred tax expense/credits differ from tax balance changes and cash taxes. Valuation allowance changes require separation of earnings from other movements.

children.label: Deferred income tax expense or benefit
Deferred income taxes and tax credits

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCredits
concepts.review_reason: This deferred-tax-and-credit measure is broader than deferred tax expense alone; identify the credits and overlap with the separately supplied deferred-tax adjustments.

children.label: Valuation Allowance Deferred Tax Asset Change In Amount

concepts.name: us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount
concepts.review_reason: The deferred tax valuation-allowance movement can include acquisitions, OCI and other non-expense changes; reconcile the earnings component before using an operating adjustment.

children.label: Operating asset and liability changes
children.classification_note: These are indirect-method movements, not universal cash receipts/payments. Exclude acquisitions, noncash movements and financing/investing balances; aggregates overlap details.

children.label: Operating balance aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: These classifications are presentation families, not instructions to sum facts. Select issuer-reconciled alternatives and preserve source signs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingAssets
concepts.review_reason: Total operating-asset changes contain receivable, prepaid and other-asset changes; select this aggregate or matched components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Total operating-liability changes contain payable, accrual and other-liability details; select the aggregate or reconciled components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingCapitalNet
concepts.review_reason: This net other-operating-capital measure overlaps other operating asset and liability changes; establish its residual exclusions before using separate details.

children.label: Operating receivable changes
children.classification_note: Total, accounts-plus-other, trade, leasing and interest receivables are overlapping scope alternatives; rental changes can already contain straight-line accruals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Total current operating receivables include accounts and other receivables; do not sum the aggregate with narrower rental, interest or related-party receivable changes.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Accounts And Other Receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Combined accounts and other receivable changes contain their separately supplied components and may be included in total operating receivables.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInLeasingReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Lease receivable changes may include straight-line rents, accrued interest or noncash lease measurement; distinguish operating rents from finance-lease principal collections.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued interest receivable net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInterestReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net accrued-interest receivable changes can already be included in aggregate operating asset changes; identify portfolio coverage before combining with other receivables.

children.label: Prepaid, deferred and other asset changes
children.classification_note: Combined prepaid/deferred/other and receivable-plus-other-asset changes overlap narrower and residual movements; current versus all operating scopes remain distinct.

children.label: Increase decrease in prepaid deferred expense and other assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidDeferredExpenseAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: This combined prepaid, deferred and other-asset movement can include the separately supplied prepaid-expense change.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidExpense
concepts.review_reason: Prepaid expenses are included in broader prepaid/deferred/other-asset changes; do not combine the subset with the aggregate.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Other Current Assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other current asset changes may overlap prepaid/deferred/other assets and other operating assets; determine the residual population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other operating asset changes can overlap net other operating capital and the combined receivable/other-asset movement; identify exclusions for rental receivables and deferred leasing costs.

children.label: Change in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableAndOtherOperatingAssets
concepts.review_reason: Combined receivable/other-operating-asset movement can contain separately reported interest, prepaid and residual asset changes.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Deposit Other Assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDepositOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Changes in deposits recorded as other assets can include acquisitions or noncash reclassification; establish operating purpose and exclusions for real-estate acquisition deposits.

children.label: Increase decrease in income taxes receivable
Payable and accrual changes
children.classification_note: Combined payable/accrual, accrued-plus-other and total operating liability movements contain narrower payable and accrual details; select consistent issuer coverage.

children.label: Increase decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accounts payable and accrued liabilities combines categories that may already be included in operating-liability changes; identify the accounts-payable increment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accrued liabilities can include interest and tax payable changes disclosed separately; determine the residual coverage.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued liabilities and other operating liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accrued and other operating liability changes combine categories that are also supplied separately; establish exclusions before using payable details.

children.label: Change in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other accounts payable/accrued liability changes are a residual within combined payables and accruals; identify exclusions for the other-accrual-only measure.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Other Accrued Liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other accrued liabilities may be included in total accruals or the combined other-payables-and-accruals change; identify the residual scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other operating liability changes can overlap total operating liabilities and the accrued-plus-other liability movement; identify exclusions for rental deposits and tax accruals.

children.label: Increase decrease in interest payable net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInInterestPayableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net interest payable changes may already be included in accrued-liability movements; isolate the interest component before using this detail.

children.label: Change in accrued income taxes payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Accrued income taxes payable are a liability-only view that can be included in net tax payable/receivable changes and the broader all-tax movement.

children.label: Increase decrease in operating lease liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease liability changes include noncash additions, interest-related effects and remeasurements; reconcile them with ROU amortization and operating lease payments.

children.label: Deferred revenue and customer obligation changes
children.classification_note: Deferred revenue and customer-contract obligations overlap; lease rental advances are not automatically customer-contract balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Deferred revenue includes deferred income and customer obligations; it can overlap the contract-with-customer liability movement and is not a standalone receipt total.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Contract With Customer Liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerLiability
concepts.review_reason: Customer-contract liability changes can be included in deferred revenue; they exclude ordinary rental lease liabilities unless the underlying customer accounting applies.

children.label: Related-party operating balances
children.classification_note: Relationship views overlap each other and trade balances; exclude funding and investment loans classified separately.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Due From Related Parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party receivable movements can concern operating trade balances or investment loans; confirm operating scope before combining with related-party loan cash flows.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Accounts Receivable Related Parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party accounts receivable are a subset of broader related-party or operating receivable changes; exclude investment-loan movements from the operating view.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Due To Related Parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party payable changes can represent operating accruals or financing advances; confirm nature and exclude debt proceeds/repayments before classifying as operating.

children.label: Increase decrease in due to affiliates

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDueToAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate payable changes are a relationship subset of related-party obligations and may contain funding; reconcile issuer operating presentation.

children.label: Other operating cash-flow presentations
children.classification_note: Explicit operating settlements and direct-method payments are alternatives to relevant indirect-method accrual reconciliations, not automatic extra flows.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeasePayments
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease payments are cash outflows that may already be reflected through lease-related operating adjustments; do not deduct them a second time.

children.label: Proceeds from insurance settlement operating activities
Held-for-sale loan operating cash flows
children.classification_note: Loans originated/acquired for sale differ from investment portfolios. Generic loan cash flows remain unresolved supplementary candidates until purpose is established.

children.label: Payments for origination of mortgage loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgageLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage held-for-sale originations exclude purchases and non-mortgage classes; distinguish this scope from combined origination-and-purchase payments.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of mortgage loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage held-for-sale loan sales are a subset of all held-for-sale loan sales; distinguish sale proceeds from sale-and-collection receipts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Sale-only held-for-sale receipts overlap combined sale-and-collection receipts but exclude their collection component; select consistent portfolio and transaction scope.

children.label: Residual operating adjustments
children.classification_note: Other reconciliation items are residual rather than totals of all operating adjustments. Net noncash income/expense overlaps income-only and expense-only views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNoncashIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other noncash income may already be included in net OtherNoncashIncomeExpense; preserve its income direction rather than treating it as an expense add-back.

children.label: Other operating activities cash flow statement

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingActivitiesCashFlowStatement
concepts.review_reason: Other operating activities is a residual cash-flow line, not an extra total above the specific operating cash flows and adjustments.

nodes.label: Investing activities
nodes.classification_note: The reported investing total organizes cash flows. Gross/net views, asset types and ownership scopes overlap; hierarchy is not an equation.

children.label: Investing cash-flow scopes
children.classification_note: Continuing and discontinued amounts are scope details of total investing cash flow, not additional receipts or payments.

children.label: Net Cash Provided By Used In Investing Activities Continuing Operations
Real-estate investing cash flows
children.classification_note: Property acquisitions, development, improvements, deposits and disposals can be included in combined real-estate/JV investment measures. No universal capex or maintenance split is inferred.

children.label: Property purchase scope alternatives
children.classification_note: General, commercial, held-for-investment, land and residual purchases describe overlapping property populations and exclude owner-used assets where definitions specify.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: This acquisition measure includes income-producing real estate but excludes owner-used property; reconcile it with commercial, held-for-investment and acquisition-plus-development alternatives.

children.label: Payments to acquire commercial real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Commercial real-estate purchases are income-producing property acquisitions that can be included in general real-estate purchases and combined development payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateHeldForInvestment
concepts.review_reason: Standalone real-estate investment purchases are included in the combined real-estate-and-joint-venture purchase scope where both are reported.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLand
concepts.review_reason: This land purchase tag excludes owner-used land and can be included in investment-property or commercial real-estate purchases.

children.label: Payments to acquire other real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Other investment real-estate purchases are a residual category and may be included in broader real-estate purchases; establish which property types are excluded.

children.label: Combined property and venture purchases
children.classification_note: Acquisition-plus-development and property-plus-JV purchases combine different dimensions and overlap separate property/development/JV flows.

children.label: Payments to acquire and develop real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: The combined acquisition-and-development amount includes income-producing property purchases and development, but excludes owner-used real estate; it overlaps separately supplied acquisition and development payments.

children.label: Investment real estate and joint venture purchases

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAndRealEstateJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: The combined real-estate/JV purchase amount includes direct property and joint-venture investments; it overlaps both investment-property purchases and equity-method/JV contributions.

children.label: Development and improvement payments
children.classification_note: Construction, development, capital improvements and tenant improvements can concern the same projects. Capital improvements may include acquisitions. Lessor initial-direct-cost payments differ from lessee lease cash flows.

children.label: Payments to develop real estate assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate development payments can be included in acquisition-and-development or construction payments; separate projects before combining those views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForConstructionInProcess
concepts.review_reason: Construction-in-process cash payments overlap real-estate development and capital-improvement payments when they concern the same projects.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForCapitalImprovements
concepts.review_reason: Capital-improvement payments include acquisitions as well as improvements of investment or owner-used properties; they are not necessarily a maintenance-only capital expenditure amount.

children.label: Lessor leasing costs and tenant improvement payments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissionsAndTenantImprovements
concepts.review_reason: The combined lessor initial-direct-cost and tenant-improvement outflow contains tenant improvements and may overlap development/capital-improvement payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForTenantImprovements
concepts.review_reason: Tenant improvements paid by the lessor are included in the combined leasing-cost/commission/improvement payment tag and can overlap capital improvements.

children.label: Property purchase deposits
children.classification_note: Net acquisition deposits overlap gross payments and eventual purchase consideration; noncash escrow settlement is retained separately.

children.label: Payments for deposits on real estate acquisitions

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForDepositsOnRealEstateAcquisitions
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate acquisition deposits can be included in the net deposit flow or final property purchase payment; identify timing and exclude reclassified noncash escrow.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from deposits on real estate acquisitions

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEstateAcquisitions
concepts.review_reason: The net real-estate acquisition deposit flow includes payments and recoveries; preserve its outflow-oriented sign and do not add separate deposit payments.

children.label: Investment property disposal receipts
children.classification_note: Investment-property, investment-land, residual real-estate and combined property/JV sale receipts overlap. Building receipts require determining the property use.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeldforinvestment
concepts.review_reason: Standalone investment real-estate sale proceeds can be contained in the combined real-estate-and-joint-venture receipt amount.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of land heldforinvestment

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldforinvestment
concepts.review_reason: Investment-land sale receipts exclude inventory and owner-used land and may be contained in broader investment-property sale proceeds.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of other real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Other real-estate sale receipts are a residual taxonomy category; establish exclusions for investment, productive and foreclosure properties before combining.

children.label: Investment real estate and joint venture proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRealEstateAndRealEstateJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: Combined real-estate/JV sale receipts can include property sale and joint-venture interest sale amounts supplied separately; establish which portfolios are included.

children.label: Investment property net flow
children.classification_note: The net purchase/sale amount is an alternative to matching gross payments and receipts, with an outflow-oriented sign.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from real estate heldforinvestment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstateHeldforinvestment
concepts.review_reason: Net investment-real-estate purchases/sales overlap gross property acquisition and sale receipts; preserve the net outflow-oriented source sign.

children.label: Joint-venture and partnership investments
children.classification_note: Equity-method, joint-venture and real-estate partnership views overlap. Operating distributions from earnings differ from return-of-capital investing receipts.

children.label: Venture purchases and capital contributions
children.classification_note: Ownership purchases and advances can overlap combined business/affiliate purchases; changes in control can alter the required cash-flow section.

children.label: Payments to acquire interest in joint venture

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJointVenture
concepts.review_reason: Joint-venture investment or advance payments may overlap equity-method purchases and the combined real-estate/JV purchase amount; distinguish capital contributions from loans.

children.label: Real estate partnership interest purchases net of cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePartnersInterestInRealEstatePartnershipNetOfCashAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Partnership-interest purchases net of cash acquired can overlap JV or equity-method investment purchases; identify ownership/control changes before choosing a cash-flow section.

children.label: Venture disposals and capital returns
children.classification_note: The non-equity-method/nonconsolidated JV disposal definition differs from equity-method disposal. Return-of-capital distributions are not disposal gains.

children.label: Equity method distributions return of capital
Sale of joint venture interests outside consolidation and equity method

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInJointVenture
concepts.review_reason: The definition excludes interests previously consolidated or equity-method accounted; keep these joint-venture sale receipts distinct from equity-method and subsidiary disposal tags.

children.label: Business acquisition and divestiture cash
children.classification_note: Cash flows must distinguish gross/net consideration, acquired/divested cash, and ownership/control changes. Acquisition-date asset allocation values are supplementary, not cash purchases.

children.label: Business purchase alternatives
children.classification_note: Gross and net-of-cash business purchases overlap combined business/affiliate payments. Pending deposits and preacquisition payments may already be included.

children.label: Business acquisitions, net of acquired cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross acquisition cash payments exclude cash acquired; reconcile them to the net acquisition payment rather than adding gross and net measures.

children.label: Payments to acquire businesses and interest in affiliates

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesAndInterestInAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: The combined business and affiliate acquisition amount overlaps business purchases and equity-method/affiliate investments; determine whether controlled-subsidiary ownership changes require financing.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherPaymentsToAcquireBusinesses
concepts.review_reason: Other business-acquisition payments include pending acquisition deposits and preacquisition costs; reconcile them to gross/net acquisition payments and real-estate deposits.

children.label: Cash acquired with businesses
children.classification_note: Acquired cash is a reconciling disclosure already reflected in acquisitions net of cash; do not count it as an extra receipt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashAcquiredFromAcquisition
concepts.review_reason: Acquired cash is already reflected in acquisitions net of cash acquired; this disclosure must not be added again as an independent investing receipt.

children.label: Business disposal cash and removed cash
children.classification_note: Gross/net divestiture receipts and cash removed upon deconsolidation require reconciliation. Retained-control ownership changes may belong in financing.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses
concepts.review_reason: Gross divestiture proceeds differ from proceeds net of cash divested; establish which disposal cash basis the issuer reports.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsidiariesAndAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Subsidiary/affiliate divestiture receipts may combine deconsolidation and sales of noncontrolled interests; determine control changes and whether retained-control transactions belong in financing.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashDivestedFromDeconsolidation
concepts.review_reason: Cash removed on deconsolidation can already be netted in divestiture proceeds; reconcile net versus gross business-sale presentation before subtracting it again.

children.label: Productive-asset cash flows
children.classification_note: Owner-used PP&E and intangible productive assets differ from income-property acquisition categories. Productive asset aggregates overlap PP&E, intangibles and residuals.

children.label: Productive-asset purchase alternatives
children.classification_note: These classifications are presentation families, not instructions to sum facts. Select issuer-reconciled alternatives and preserve source signs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset purchases may cover PP&E and other productive assets; reconcile the acquisition scope with separately reported capital expenditures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets
concepts.review_reason: Acquired intangibles exclude goodwill but may be included in productive-asset payments; distinguish direct purchases from acquisition-date allocation values.

children.label: Payments to acquire other property plant and equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Other PP&E purchase/improvement payments can be contained in total PP&E or productive-asset purchases; establish the residual asset population.

children.label: Payments To Acquire Other Productive Assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other productive-asset purchases/improvements are a residual of tangible or intangible capital spending; establish exclusions for separately supplied PP&E and intangibles.

children.label: Productive-asset sale alternatives
children.classification_note: Formerly productive property held for sale, PP&E, buildings and all productive assets are overlapping asset-use views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset sale proceeds cover PP&E, software and other intangibles and can contain PP&E-only or formerly productive property sale receipts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
Proceeds from sale of property held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: These receipts concern formerly productive property held for sale, not an unrestricted category of all inventory property sales; distinguish investment-property and productive-asset receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfBuildings
concepts.review_reason: Building sale receipts can be included in investment-property, PP&E or productive-asset proceeds depending on use; do not sum overlapping asset views.

children.label: Productive-asset net flow
children.classification_note: Net productive-asset purchases and disposals replace matching gross presentations; preserve outflow-oriented source direction.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from productive assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Net productive-asset purchases and disposals overlap gross asset purchases/sales; preserve its outflow-oriented sign and select a consistent net or gross view.

children.label: Securities and other investments
children.classification_note: All-investment and marketable/maturity/asset-class views overlap. Cash-equivalent transfers do not become investing flows solely because called investments.

children.label: All-investment flow alternatives
children.classification_note: The net investment flow overlaps gross all-investment purchases and sale/maturity/collection receipts; no arithmetic across these alternatives is implied.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInvestments
concepts.review_reason: All-investment purchases overlap security-class, maturity and other-investment purchase disclosures; select the aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Total investment sale, maturity and collection proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: All-investment sale, maturity and collection proceeds include separately mapped portfolios and receipt types; do not add the aggregate to its underlying receipts.

children.label: Marketable and maturity-based investments
children.classification_note: Marketable receipts may include AFS or HTM instruments. Short-term investing assets are not automatically cash equivalents; views overlap security-class flows.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security purchases can overlap AFS debt, FV-NI equity and maturity-based purchase groups; establish the issuer instrument coverage.

children.label: Marketable security sale and maturity proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security sale/maturity proceeds cover HTM or AFS instruments and can include separately mapped AFS receipts; do not assume a separate portfolio.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Short-term investment purchases qualify as investing activity and can include trading securities acquired for investment; they are not purchases of all cash equivalents.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireHeldToMaturitySecurities
concepts.review_reason: Held-to-maturity purchases cover long-term securities and can be contained in broader marketable or all-investment purchases; distinguish them from AFS purchases.

children.label: AFS debt security flows
children.classification_note: Sales and maturities/prepayments/calls are contained in the combined AFS receipt. MBS is a debt-security subset, not an additional portfolio by default.

children.label: AFS debt maturities, prepayments and calls
AFS debt sale and maturity proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableForSaleSecurities
concepts.review_reason: This AFS debt aggregate includes sales, maturities, prepayments and calls; do not add it to the separate AFS sale and maturity-related receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBSCategorizedAsAvailableForSale
concepts.review_reason: AFS MBS purchases are an instrument subset of total AFS debt purchases; do not add to that total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBSCategorizedAsAvailableForSale
concepts.review_reason: AFS MBS sale proceeds can be included in total AFS debt-security sale proceeds and combined sale/maturity receipts.

children.label: FV-NI equity security cash
children.classification_note: Equity sale proceeds are cash receipts and differ from realized/unrealized earnings adjustments; they may be included in broader investment receipts.

children.label: Other investment cash
children.classification_note: Residual investment purchases and sales may be included in broader investment totals; establish the excluded asset classes.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of other investments
Investment loans and servicing assets
children.classification_note: Loan and lease portfolio views overlap; investing placement requires investment purpose. Generic flows without that purpose remain supplementary review candidates.

children.label: Investment loan purchase views
children.classification_note: Held-for-investment, finance-receivable and mortgage-note purchases may describe the same assets.

children.label: Payments to acquire loans held for investment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansHeldForInvestment
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-investment loan purchases overlap mortgage-note, finance-receivable and generic loan acquisitions; do not combine portfolio views without reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Finance-receivable purchases can include the separately supplied investment-loan and mortgage-note purchases; establish asset classes and investing classification.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage-note purchases are a real-estate-secured subset of note or investment-loan purchases; establish portfolio coverage before combining.

children.label: Investment loan collection views
children.classification_note: Loan/lease principal collections include more asset classes than finance receivables; mortgage note receipts combine sales and collections and explicitly exclude operating cash flow.

children.label: Proceeds From Principal Repayments On Loans And Leases Held For Investment

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsOnLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestment
concepts.review_reason: Investment loan and lease principal repayments include lease collections and exclude interest; they overlap loan-only and finance-receivable collections.

children.label: Proceeds From Collection Of Finance Receivables
Mortgage note sale and collection receipts

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfMortgageNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage-note sale and collection receipts explicitly exclude operating cash flows; they overlap narrower note collection and sale receipts and include both events.

children.label: Investment loan sale views
children.classification_note: Held-for-investment loan sales can overlap finance-receivable sale proceeds; distinguish investment loans from loans held for resale.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of loans held for investment
Proceeds from sale of finance receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Finance-receivable sales may include mortgage or other loan sales and can overlap broader sale receipts; verify held-for-investment versus held-for-sale classification.

children.label: Net investment lending flow
children.classification_note: Net originations/collections replace matching gross loan funding and collections; preserve inflow/outflow orientation from the source.

children.label: Loan lease origination and collection flows net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndPrincipalCollections1
concepts.review_reason: Net loan/lease originations and principal collections overlap gross lending payments and collections; they are not a separate inflow to add to a gross presentation.

children.label: Related-party investment lending
children.classification_note: Notes versus long-term loans are overlapping legal-form and maturity views; funding, principal collections and operating balances remain distinct.

children.label: Payments To Fund Longterm Loans To Related Parties
Origination of notes receivable from related parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:OriginationOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party note originations can be included in long-term related-party lending payments; establish maturity and borrower scope before combining.

children.label: Proceeds from collection of longterm loans to related parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongtermLoansToRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Long-term related-party loan collections can contain related-party note collections; distinguish investment advances from operating receivable changes.

children.label: Repayment of notes receivable from related parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party note collections can be included in long-term related-party loan collections and broader note receipts; identify the same borrower population.

children.label: Mortgage servicing rights cash flows
children.classification_note: MSR acquisition and sale cash is distinct from mortgage loan principal, but can be contained in broad intangible or asset sale cash.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServicingRightsMSR
concepts.review_reason: MSR acquisition cash payments differ from mortgage loan funding and can be included in intangible asset purchases; distinguish originated from separately purchased rights.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServicingRightsMSR
concepts.review_reason: MSR sale proceeds are cash receipts, distinct from servicing amortization and impairment adjustments; check whether included in other-asset sale proceeds.

children.label: Investing nonhedging derivative cash
children.classification_note: Definitions explicitly exclude designated hedges. Net derivative flow overlaps gross receipts/payments; use one reconciled view.

children.label: Investing derivative payments and proceeds, net
Other investing cash
children.classification_note: Insurance investing settlements exclude operating insurance receipts. Capitalized interest paid may already be in development spending; residual flows require issuer exclusions.

children.label: Proceeds from insurance settlement investing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Insurance settlements classified as investing must relate to investing assets; do not assume the same classification for operating insurance recoveries.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPaidCapitalized
concepts.review_reason: Capitalized interest paid is explicitly an investing cash outflow; it may be embedded in development payments and in supplemental interest paid, so do not count it twice.

children.label: Other investing payments and proceeds, net

nodes.label: Financing activities
nodes.classification_note: The reported financing total organizes borrowing, owner and settlement flows. Overlapping debt/equity axes are not additive components.

children.label: Financing cash-flow scopes
children.classification_note: Continuing/discontinued amounts are details of total financing cash flow, not additional flows.

children.label: Net Cash Provided By Used In Financing Activities Continuing Operations
Debt financing cash flows
children.classification_note: Maturity, collateral, bank/note form, seniority and lender relationship are overlapping classification axes. Net and gross views are alternatives; noncash debt is supplementary.

children.label: Debt aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: Gross all-debt proceeds and repayments overlap instrument details; net-of-cost receipts cannot be reduced by the same issuance costs again. Combined debt/capital/lease payments include finance-lease principal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: All-debt issuance proceeds contain maturity, collateral, seniority and instrument-specific proceeds and differ from the net-of-issuance-cost amount.

children.label: Proceeds From Debt Net Of Issuance Costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Debt proceeds net of issuance costs are an alternative to gross proceeds less separate issuance-cost payments; do not subtract those costs again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: Total debt repayments include short- and long-term debt but exclude lease obligations; do not add maturity, secured or senior repayment views to this aggregate.

children.label: Debt capital security and finance lease repayments

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecurities
concepts.review_reason: This repayment aggregate includes debt, mandatorily redeemable securities and finance-lease principal; do not add separate debt or lease principal payments.

children.label: Maturity-based debt flows
children.classification_note: Long-term/short-term debt and residual long-term categories overlap other collateral and instrument views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Gross short-term debt repayments overlap net short-term borrowing flows; do not combine net and gross presentations without matched proceeds.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of other long term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other long-term repayments overlap other debt and long-term debt totals as well as the supplied net other-long-term flow.

children.label: Collateral-based debt flows
children.classification_note: Secured and unsecured views can overlap long-term, senior, mortgage bond or bank debt. The net secured flow excludes tax-exempt secured debt.

children.label: Proceeds From Issuance Of Secured Debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: Secured repayments describe long-term debt by collateral and exclude tax-exempt secured debt; they can overlap long-term and senior repayments.

children.label: Proceeds From Issuance Of Unsecured Debt
Proceeds from repayments of secured debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfSecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: The net secured long-term borrowing flow excludes tax-exempt secured debt and overlaps gross secured proceeds and repayments; preserve the net inflow-oriented sign.

children.label: Credit-line flows
children.classification_note: All, long-term, unsecured and collateralized-net lines overlap. Borrowing capacity is not cash proceeds; match the actual drawn balance and period flow.

children.label: Proceeds From Long Term Lines Of Credit

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Long-term credit-line proceeds are a maturity subset of all credit-line proceeds and may overlap unsecured credit-line receipts.

children.label: Repayments Of Long Term Lines Of Credit

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Long-term credit-line repayments are contained in broader line-of-credit repayments and may overlap secured or unsecured debt repayment views.

children.label: Proceeds from unsecured lines of credit

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromUnsecuredLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Unsecured credit-line proceeds can overlap total or long-term line draws but are excluded from the collateralized net credit-line tag.

children.label: Secured credit-line proceeds and repayments, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Despite the broad name, this net line-of-credit measure is collateralized and spans short- and long-term maturities; it is not equivalent to unsecured-line proceeds.

children.label: Note and bond instrument flows
children.classification_note: Note proceeds/repayments and long-term net note flows overlap seniority, collateral and maturity views; medium-term notes have 5-10 year maturities.

children.label: Proceeds From Repayments Of Notes Payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfNotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: The net note-payable flow concerns long-term debt and overlaps separately reported note borrowings and repayments; it is inflow-oriented.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of medium term notes

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes
concepts.review_reason: Medium-term note proceeds concern regularly issued debt with 5-10 year maturities and may be included in note-payable or long-term debt receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBond
concepts.review_reason: First-mortgage bond repayments are secured long-term debt payments that may also be reported in senior, secured or total long-term repayments.

children.label: Senior, convertible and bank borrowing flows
children.classification_note: Seniority, conversion rights, bank funding and construction purpose are overlapping debt views rather than additive classes.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of senior long term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt
concepts.review_reason: Senior long-term debt repayments classify by priority and may overlap secured, total long-term and all-debt repayment views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfConvertibleDebt
concepts.review_reason: Convertible debt repayments are a subset of long-term debt payments; cash repayment excludes any noncash conversion disclosed separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromConstructionLoansPayable
concepts.review_reason: Construction borrowings may be included in secured, bank or long-term debt receipts; they are funding and must not offset construction cash spending by default.

children.label: Related-party borrowing flows
children.classification_note: Gross related-party receipts/repayments overlap their net flow and must be excluded from operating related-party balances.

children.label: Proceeds From Repayments Of Related Party Debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt
concepts.review_reason: Related-party net debt flow overlaps gross related-party proceeds and repayments; it must be reconciled independently of operating related-party payable changes.

children.label: Other debt flows
children.classification_note: Other debt may contain other long-term amounts; establish issuer residual exclusions before combining.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other-debt repayments can include other long-term debt; establish residual debt classes before using both tags.

children.label: Finance-lease principal cash
children.classification_note: Principal is financing; interest is separate. Principal may already be included in the combined debt/capital-security/lease repayment aggregate.

children.label: Equity and ownership cash flows
children.classification_note: Aggregate equity flows overlap instrument, award-plan and contributor views. Retained-control subsidiary ownership changes differ from investing control acquisitions.

children.label: All-equity issuance receipts
children.classification_note: All-equity issuance receipts contain common, preferred, treasury stock, warrants/options and other equity receipts; use aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance or sale of equity

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: All-equity issuance receipts include common, preferred, treasury stock and option-related proceeds; choose the aggregate or reconciled instrument details.

children.label: Common and preferred issuance
children.classification_note: Preferred, callable and convertible preferred are overlapping instrument views. IPO receipts may be included in common issuance.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of redeemable preferred stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemablePreferredStock
concepts.review_reason: Callable preferred-stock issuance may be included in all-preferred or all-equity proceeds; match the instrument population before adding receipts.

children.label: Proceeds From Issuance Of Convertible Preferred Stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertiblePreferredStock
concepts.review_reason: Convertible preferred issuance is a subset of preferred or all-equity proceeds and does not include noncash conversion value.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance initial public offering
Plan, warrant and reinvestment receipts
children.classification_note: The incentive-plan aggregate includes stock options and overlaps stock-plan proceeds; dividend reinvestment must involve cash proceeds rather than stock settlement.

children.label: Incentive plan issuance receipts including options

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncentiveAndShareBasedCompensationPlansIncludingStockOptions
concepts.review_reason: This award-plan issuance aggregate includes stock options and can overlap option exercise and stock-plan proceeds; select the aggregate or matched components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStockDividendReinvestmentPlan
concepts.review_reason: Dividend-reinvestment-plan receipts can already be included in common-stock issuance; do not infer cash proceeds from dividends settled directly in stock.

children.label: Equity repurchase views
children.classification_note: All-equity, common, preferred, redeemable preferred and other-equity repurchases overlap. ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity is defined as a net share transaction despite its title.

children.label: Total common and preferred stock repurchases

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: Total equity repurchase payments overlap common, preferred, other equity and potentially redeemable preferred buybacks; identify which instruments the issuer aggregate includes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferredStock
concepts.review_reason: Callable preferred stock reacquisitions can overlap preferred and all-equity repurchases; establish the instrument population before combining.

children.label: Payments For Repurchase Of Other Equity

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEquity
concepts.review_reason: Other-equity repurchases are a residual included in broader equity repurchases; establish exclusions for common, preferred and redeemable interests.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: Despite the title, the definition describes net share transaction cash inflow or outflow; it is not a standalone gross repurchase receipt and overlaps net equity flow alternatives.

children.label: Noncontrolling ownership changes
children.classification_note: Net NCI receipts/payments exclude dividends but overlap gross ownership flows and redeemable NCI redemptions; control changes require issuer context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders
