concepts.review_reason: Noncontrolling funding receipts overlap the net noncontrolling ownership flow; they exclude the separately classified dividend presentation only when reconciled to issuer disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: These payments reduce noncontrolling ownership and exclude dividends; do not combine gross payments with the net noncontrolling ownership flow.

children.label: Noncontrolling interest proceeds and payments, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: This net noncontrolling ownership flow excludes dividends and overlaps separate noncontrolling receipts and payments; use a matched net or gross presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable noncontrolling-interest redemptions can overlap other ownership payments; distinguish redemption from dividends and changes in control.

children.label: Capital contribution receipts
children.classification_note: Contributed capital, affiliate and partnership receipts can describe the same owner contribution; identify contributor and consolidated scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributedCapital
concepts.review_reason: Contributed capital may include affiliate, partnership and common-equity funding; identify contributor and avoid adding overlapping issuance receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate contributions may already be reported within contributed capital or partnership/NCI proceeds; determine contributor and consolidated entity scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPartnershipContribution
concepts.review_reason: Cash partner contributions may overlap contributed capital, affiliate receipts or noncontrolling-interest contributions; identify partnership ownership scope.

children.label: Award tax withholding payments
children.classification_note: Net-settlement tax withholding differs from expense and option exercise proceeds; establish any inclusion in share repurchase totals.

children.label: Dividends and owner distributions
children.classification_note: The broad cash distribution aggregate includes capital distributions; ordinary dividends include common, preferred and NCI. Recipient and distribution-type views overlap.

children.label: Distribution aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: PaymentsOfDividends includes ordinary and capital distributions; PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends excludes capital distributions. Choose a reconciled aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividends
concepts.review_reason: This cash distribution aggregate includes capital distributions and noncontrolling interests as well as common and preferred dividends; reconcile its scope to ordinary dividends and ownership payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends
concepts.review_reason: Ordinary dividends include common, preferred and noncontrolling recipients, while PaymentsOfDividends can also include capital distributions; reconcile alternative totals.

children.label: Dividends by recipient
children.classification_note: Common, preferred and NCI dividends may be components of ordinary distributions; affiliate and limited-partner recipients can overlap those ownership groups.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDistributionsToAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate earnings distributions may include recipient amounts also reported as noncontrolling, partnership or ordinary dividends; identify ownership scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DistributionMadeToLimitedPartnerCashDistributionsPaid
concepts.review_reason: Cash distributions to limited partners may be included in noncontrolling-interest dividends or capital distributions; identify recipient and earnings-versus-capital scope.

children.label: Capital distributions
children.classification_note: Capital distributions exclude ordinary dividends and can be included in the broad cash distribution aggregate; special dividends are included here.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfCapitalDistribution
concepts.review_reason: Capital distributions exclude ordinary dividends and include special dividends; reconcile them against the broader PaymentsOfDividends cash distribution aggregate.

children.label: Financing and issuance cost cash
children.classification_note: Combined debt/equity costs overlap standalone debt, financing, stock and loan cost payments. Debt extinguishment cash costs differ from earnings loss and principal.

children.label: Payment Of Financing And Stock Issuance Costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Combined financing and stock issuance costs include debt origination and equity issuance costs; do not add separate payment categories to this aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Equity issuance costs are included in the combined financing-and-stock-issuance-cost payment amount; select the separate or combined presentation.

children.label: Financing derivative and hedge cash
children.classification_note: Nonhedging derivative definitions exclude designated hedges. Each net view overlaps its gross payments/receipts; hedge and nonhedge populations remain separate.

children.label: Financing nonhedging derivatives
children.classification_note: Net payments/proceeds overlap gross derivative payments and receipts and exclude designated hedges.

children.label: Payments for derivative instrument financing activities
Proceeds from derivative instrument financing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentFinancingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Net financing derivative flows exclude designated hedges and contain gross derivative receipts/payments; they differ from the separately supplied hedge cash flows.

children.label: Financing designated hedge settlements
children.classification_note: Net designated hedge payments/receipts overlap hedge payments; they differ from derivatives explicitly excluding hedges.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Net financing hedge settlements cover designated hedges and overlap hedge payments; they are distinct from financing derivative flows that exclude designated hedges.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForHedgeFinancingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Financing hedge payments are part of the supplied net hedge settlement flow; they are not additional to that net measure or non-hedging derivatives.

children.label: Other financing cash
children.classification_note: Other financing is a residual; establish exclusions for identified funding, distribution and issuance-cost categories.

children.label: Other financing proceeds and payments, net

nodes.label: Cash reconciliation
nodes.classification_note: Changes are duration facts and balances are instant facts. Match cash population, dates and FX scope; missing values are not zero.

children.label: Cash change measures
children.classification_note: Including-FX and excluding-FX changes are alternative measures of total cash/restricted cash including disposal groups and discontinued operations; do not add them.

children.label: Change in total cash and restricted cash including FX
Change in total cash and restricted cash excluding FX
Cash exchange effects
children.classification_note: The supplied FX measure is continuing-operation cash/restricted cash, not necessarily the FX effect for the total including discontinued operations.

children.label: FX effect on cash - continuing operations
Cash balance scopes
children.classification_note: Total including discontinued/disposal cash differs from continuing-operation cash. Restricted cash and restricted cash/equivalents overlap and are components, not extra cash.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash - including discontinued operations
Cash and restricted cash - continuing operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash and cash equivalents are components of broader cash reconciliation balances, not additional cash to add to those totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCash
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash alone excludes restricted cash equivalents and can already be included in the combined restricted-cash disclosure.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Supplemental cash payments, noncash transactions, acquisition allocations and unresolved candidates are retained distinctly from primary activity totals.

children.label: Supplemental cash payments
children.classification_note: These disclosures overlap cash amounts already included in operating, investing or financing totals; do not add them as a fourth cash-flow section.

children.label: Cash interest disclosures
children.classification_note: Interest paid net, gross and finance-lease interest overlap; capitalized interest paid is explicitly investing and mapped there.

children.label: Operating interest paid, excluding capitalized interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross interest paid can contain finance lease interest already disclosed separately; do not add overlapping payment disclosures.

children.label: Finance lease interest payment on liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestPaymentOnLiability
concepts.review_reason: Finance-lease interest paid can already be included in supplemental interest paid and operating lease-related cash presentations; it must not be added to principal repayments.

children.label: Cash tax disclosures
children.classification_note: Gross taxes, net-of-refund taxes, federal net tax and refund receipts overlap. Refunds are not an extra receipt after selecting net taxes.

children.label: Income taxes paid, net of refunds

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross income tax payments differ from net-of-refund payments and jurisdiction-specific payment disclosures.

children.label: Income tax paid federal after refund received

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived
concepts.review_reason: Federal tax paid after refunds is a jurisdiction-specific net amount; distinguish it from federal gross payments and all-jurisdiction net tax.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds
concepts.review_reason: Tax refunds are cash inflows already netted in IncomeTaxesPaidNet; the disclosure is not an extra receipt to add after selecting a net tax measure.

children.label: Noncash acquisition and disposal transactions
children.classification_note: Only the noncash portion is represented by these tags; do not treat values as acquisition cash payments, disposal receipts or debt borrowings.

children.label: Assets received in noncash acquisitions
children.classification_note: Broad values, fair values, fixed assets, investments and residual assets are overlapping scope/measurement views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfAssetsAcquired1
concepts.review_reason: The definition covers the noncash portion of assets or businesses acquired in noncash or part-noncash acquisitions; it is not total cash consideration or a second property purchase.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueOfAssetsAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Fair value of assets acquired measures acquisition value and can include assets financed through assumed liabilities or equity rather than cash.

children.label: Net book value of nonmonetary assets exchanged

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionNetNonmonetaryAssetsAcquiredLiabilitiesAssumed1
concepts.review_reason: This definition measures net book value of nonmonetary assets transferred or exchanged in a noncash acquisition; it is neither net cash paid nor an acquisition-date identifiable net-asset allocation.

children.label: Liabilities assumed in noncash acquisitions
children.classification_note: Total assumed liabilities, fair-value liabilities, debt, notes and payables overlap. No amounts are cash debt proceeds or repayments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfLiabilitiesAssumed1
concepts.review_reason: Acquisition liabilities assumed can represent noncash financing; identify their inclusion in total liabilities assumed before aggregating acquisition disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesAssumed1
concepts.review_reason: Liabilities assumed can overlap the acquisition-specific and identifiable-liability disclosures; it does not establish repayment cash outflow.

children.label: Noncash sale and property consideration
children.classification_note: Noncash consideration, seller mortgages and property contributions differ from cash sale proceeds and equity funding receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueOfConsiderationGiven1
concepts.review_reason: Noncash consideration given must be separated from cash acquisition payments and identified by transaction.

children.label: Business combination consideration and allocation
children.classification_note: Acquisition-date recognized asset values are not cash spent on those individual assets. Instant allocation balances preserve official period types; gross/net and goodwill scopes differ.

children.label: Combination consideration values
children.classification_note: Total consideration can contain cash, noncash and contingent components; issued/issuable equity is not a cash share issuance receipt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1
concepts.review_reason: Total consideration transferred can include cash, equity and contingent consideration; isolate the cash component before using an acquisition cash-flow measure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable
concepts.review_reason: Equity interests issued or issuable as acquisition consideration are a noncash component, not cash stock issuance proceeds.

children.label: Combination acquired asset values
children.classification_note: Assets, net identifiable assets and net assets including goodwill are overlapping acquisition-date measures. Component allocations are not additional purchase cash flows.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedAssets
concepts.review_reason: Acquired identifiable assets are instant acquisition-date balances; they are not equal to acquisition cash paid.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedNet
concepts.review_reason: Net acquired identifiable assets and liabilities is an instant purchase-price-allocation measure, not acquisition net cash flow.

children.label: Business combination net assets including goodwill

concepts.name: us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Below-market leases acquired are acquisition-date intangible amounts rather than amortization or cash paid; keep them in acquisition disclosures.

children.label: Noncash capital and financing transactions
children.classification_note: No separate cash flow is inferred from share, debt or lease recognition, conversion or transfers.

children.label: Noncash share values
children.classification_note: Stock issued, stock-settled dividends and values issued for awards or services differ from cash issuance proceeds, recognized compensation and cash dividends.

children.label: Common stock dividends paid in stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:DividendsCommonStockStock
concepts.review_reason: Stock-settled common dividends include declared paid and unpaid amounts and do not constitute cash dividend payments.

children.label: Gross share compensation shares issued value

concepts.name: us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCompensationGross
concepts.review_reason: The gross value of shares issued under compensation plans is before forfeitures and excludes ESOP; it is neither expense recognized nor cash issuance proceeds.

children.label: Noncash stock and warrants for services or claims

concepts.name: us-gaap:IssuanceOfStockAndWarrantsForServicesOrClaims
concepts.review_reason: Stock or warrants issued for services or claims are noncash settlement values; reconcile any related expense already included in compensation or other earnings adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConversionOfStockAmountConverted1
concepts.review_reason: The value of stock converted is noncash consideration surrendered, not a repurchase payment; it is a different side of conversion from the value of instruments issued.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConversionOfStockAmountIssued1
concepts.review_reason: The value of instruments issued in a stock conversion is noncash settlement, not equity cash proceeds; it differs from the value of the stock surrendered for conversion.

children.label: Noncash debt and lease transactions
children.classification_note: Notes issued/retired, mortgage transfers, new lease obligations and ROU assets acquired are noncash. Paid-in-kind interest and costs incurred differ from cash interest and debt costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NotesIssued1
concepts.review_reason: Notes issued at fair value in noncash investing/financing transactions are not cash note proceeds, even when an acquisition also has a cash-funded portion.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtIssuanceCostsIncurredDuringNoncashOrPartialNoncashTransaction
concepts.review_reason: Debt issuance costs incurred in a noncash or partly noncash transaction are not necessarily cash costs paid in this period; separate their financing and recognition bases.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements; exclude them from cash capital expenditures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFinanceLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Finance ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements, separate from principal payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalLeaseObligationsIncurred
concepts.review_reason: Capital lease obligations incurred are a historical noncash financing measure; distinguish them from finance lease cash principal payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaidInKindInterest
concepts.review_reason: Paid-in-kind interest is a noncash interest payment, not interest paid in cash; reconcile it to debt balance changes and the issuer operating adjustment.

children.label: Capital expenditures not yet paid
children.classification_note: Unpaid capex and unpaid construction are overlapping incurred amounts, not cash spending in the current period.

children.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred But Not Yet Paid

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalExpendituresIncurredButNotYetPaid
concepts.review_reason: Capital expenditures incurred but not yet paid concern recognition without current-period cash settlement; they can include the separately disclosed unpaid construction expenditures.

children.label: Construction in progress expenditures incurred but not yet paid
Portfolio and property reclassifications
children.classification_note: Transfers among loans, REO, held-for-sale and investment accounts do not create cash purchases, sales or collections.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferToOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Transfers into other real estate generally reflect collateral taken or asset reclassification; they are not cash real-estate acquisition payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines this as transfers out of real estate owned in noncash transactions; do not treat it as real-estate sale proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Transfers of investments are noncash movements whose direction and portfolios require context; do not infer sale or purchase cash flows.

children.label: Portfolio loans and leases transferred to held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfPortfolioLoansAndLeasesToHeldForSale1
concepts.review_reason: Portfolio loans transferred to held for sale change classification without constituting loan sales or cash originations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfLoansHeldForSaleToPortfolioLoans1
concepts.review_reason: Loans transferred from held for sale to portfolio are a noncash reclassification, not a new investing loan purchase.

children.label: Property, financing and accrual supporting disclosures
children.classification_note: Schedule expenses, rollforwards, capitalized costs and ending balances support reconciliation but do not independently establish cash receipts/payments.

children.label: Schedule III investment real estate depreciation

concepts.name: us-gaap:SECScheduleIIIRealEstateAccumulatedDepreciationDepreciationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Schedule III depreciation covers investment real estate and may differ from cash-flow depreciation due to scope or consolidations; retain it as a schedule disclosure rather than a second add-back.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditions
concepts.review_reason: PP&E additions measure recognized asset increases and may include unpaid, acquired or noncash assets; they do not establish cash capital expenditure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstatePeriodIncreaseDecrease
concepts.review_reason: The gross investment-real-estate rollforward movement is before accumulated depreciation and includes noncash changes; it is not net cash paid for property.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalized
concepts.review_reason: Interest capitalization is an accrual allocation and can include unpaid interest; it does not equal cash interest capitalized in investing activities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalizedAdjustment
concepts.review_reason: The capitalized-interest adjustment reconciles interest incurred and capitalization; it does not establish interest paid in cash or an independent operating add-back.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationAllocationOfRecognizedPeriodCostsCapitalizedAmount
concepts.review_reason: Capitalized share-based payment cost is not automatically an expense add-back in operating cash flow.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredOfferingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Deferred offering costs are an ending asset balance, not current-period cash issuance costs; retain the instant disclosure separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ReplacementReserveEscrow
concepts.review_reason: Replacement reserve escrow is an ending restricted amount, not a period cash outflow; determine inclusion in restricted cash before treating funding as a cash transfer.

children.label: Revenue recognized from customer contract liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized
concepts.review_reason: Revenue recognized from previously deferred customer obligations is not current-period cash collected; it can overlap contract-liability change reconciliations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ExtinguishmentOfDebtAmount
concepts.review_reason: Gross debt extinguished can be settled through cash, refinancing or noncash exchanges; it is not a cash repayment measure.

children.label: Cash-flow candidates requiring issuer presentation
children.classification_note: Do not include these candidates in primary activity totals until cash nature, portfolio purpose, role and cash-flow section are resolved. Concept-specific reasons identify the missing evidence.

children.label: Loan cash flows with unresolved portfolio purpose
children.classification_note: Generic note and loan cash flows may be operating held-for-sale flows or investing portfolio flows; source purpose determines classification.

children.label: Proceeds from collection of notes receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Note principal collections can include mortgage and related-party notes and are also contained in sale-and-collection aggregates; identify portfolio and cash-flow section.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Note purchases can include mortgage notes and other loans, potentially with accrued interest; establish investment purpose versus resale and overlap with specialized mortgage purchases.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Loan-receivable purchases can overlap finance-receivable acquisitions and net lending flows; establish contract coverage before choosing the gross purchase amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Generic loan collections can include finance-receivable, mortgage-note or related-party note principal; establish portfolio purpose and operating-versus-investing classification.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from loans receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Net loan-receivable payments/proceeds can include origination and collection flows covered by other loan measures; identify the lending portfolio and netting basis.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Generic loan-sale receipts may concern held-for-sale operating assets or investment loans; verify the portfolio and issuer classification before assigning investing cash flow.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of notes receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Note sale receipts are included in sale-and-collection aggregates and may overlap mortgage-note sale receipts; preserve portfolio and held-for-sale classification.

children.label: Note receivable sale and collection proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Combined note sale and collection receipts contain their separate sale and principal collection measures and may include mortgage notes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanOriginations1
concepts.review_reason: Despite its name, this tag describes cash inflows associated with mortgage or lease origination, not cash advanced to borrowers; identify the transaction and section before assigning it.

children.label: Ownership flows requiring control analysis
children.classification_note: Additional interests in controlled subsidiaries without control change may be financing; unconsolidated investment acquisitions may be investing.

children.label: Payments to acquire interest in subsidiaries and affiliates

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesAndAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: This tag includes advances to unconsolidated entities and additional interests in controlled subsidiaries; changes without loss of control may require financing rather than investing classification.

children.label: Balance and expense movements requiring cash reconciliation
children.classification_note: Accrual expense, acquisition remeasurement and balance movements are not necessarily noncash operating adjustments or actual cash paid; retain outside primary totals pending reconciliation.

children.label: Change in deferred income tax balances

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Deferred income tax balance changes may include acquisitions, OCI and currency effects; they are not interchangeable with deferred tax expense.

children.label: Increase decrease in deferred leasing fees

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLeasingFees
concepts.review_reason: Deferred initial direct leasing cost changes can include capitalization, amortization and acquisition effects; they are not equivalent to cash leasing commissions or tenant improvements.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInSecurityDeposits
concepts.review_reason: Security deposit changes do not identify deposits received versus posted or distinguish refundable liabilities from asset balances; cash-flow classification requires issuer context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInNotesReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Note receivable balance changes can include originations, collections, disposals and noncash changes; they do not establish an operating cash-flow adjustment without portfolio reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationLiability1
concepts.review_reason: Contingent consideration liability changes include remeasurement and settlement differences, not a pure cash payment; isolate earnings effects from acquisition and financing cash flows.

children.label: Deferred compensation arrangement with individual compensation expense

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualCompensationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Individual deferred-compensation expense can include accruals and cash settlement effects; use a noncash adjustment only after reconciling payments and liability movements.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Other income-tax expense can include current or deferred tax components; it is not itself a tax cash payment or an automatic noncash tax adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfLoanCosts
concepts.review_reason: Loan origination costs paid can overlap financing/debt issuance costs; establish borrower-versus-lender role and issuer cash-flow section before using this financing candidate.

children.label: Reverse-repurchase cash requiring purpose analysis
children.classification_note: Determine investment lending versus operating/trading purpose before assigning reverse-repurchase cash outflows.

children.label: Payments for securities purchased under agreements to resell

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResell
concepts.review_reason: Reverse-repurchase cash payments acquire financing assets; determine investment-versus-operating trading purpose before assigning them to investing.
